verdict.line: You lose if you let Darius stack Hemorrhage to 5 in extended trades, but you win if you engage in short bursts and disengage before his Passive (Hemorrhage) enrages him.

brief.thesis: This matchup is a race between Aatrox's burst-and-heal trade pattern and Darius's stacking bleed: every second you stay in range of Darius adds a Hemorrhage stack, and at 5 stacks he enrages with massive bonus Attack Damage, so the lane is won by whoever controls the duration of each trade, not who lands the first hit. At 50.2% Aatrox win rate over 203 games this is close to even, but the structural danger is entirely on Aatrox's side if trades run long.

theirWindow.what: Disengage immediately with E (Umbral Dash) — staying in range invites Q (Decimate) or a stacked R (Noxian Guillotine) that scales with your stack count and deals true damage.

yourWindow.when: Your Q (The Darkin Blade) and W (Infernal Chains) are both up
yourWindow.what: Engage hard with W to pull him in on your terms, then land Q swings; your E (Umbral Dash) passively heals you on every ability hit, so front-loading damage before he can stack Hemorrhage favors you.

start.why: Highest pick rate (73.2%) and win rate (51% over 202 games) start; the extra AD and sustain fuel short trades before Darius can stack Hemorrhage.

boots.why: 82.9% pick, 50.9% win rate; reduces the physical damage from his autos and Q (Decimate) blade hits, and OP.GG explicitly flags these as the pick to manage his damage.

core.why: Most run core start (13.9% pick at 65% win in the Eclipse line) and its burst shield rewards your short, decisive trade pattern.
Second item in the top build path; the proc heal stacks with E (Umbral Dash) sustain to win prolonged skirmishes.
Final item in the most successful path (65% win, 20 games); damage-over-time conversion directly counters his true-damage R (Noxian Guillotine) burst windows.

you want faster ability haste to shorten your Q/W/E cooldowns and re-engage before he resets Hemorrhage stacks

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest combined pick rate (44.9%) among all pages; Conqueror's stacking damage and healing directly offsets Darius's Hemorrhage sustain in the extended part of a trade.

summoners.why: Highest pick rate (83.2%) and win rate (50.7%) combo; Ignite denies his Q (Decimate) healing on hit and closes out all-ins before he can stack Hemorrhage to enrage.

playing.title: Bait his E (Apprehend) first
playing.detail: Apprehend has a 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s cooldown and 535 range — walk to the edge of it early in the level 1-2 window and punish the whiff with your own engage, since he has no pull for the rest of the trade.

playing.title: Trade in one burst, then leave
playing.detail: Land W (Infernal Chains) to pull him to center for double damage, follow with Q (The Darkin Blade) swings, then disengage with E (Umbral Dash) before 3 Hemorrhage stacks accumulate.

playing.title: Track his W (Crippling Strike) for chase potential
playing.detail: Crippling Strike slows on his next attack (5s cooldown) — do not walk away in a straight line after trading, cut at an angle to avoid getting caught by the slow.

playing.title: Save E (Umbral Dash) to punish his all-in
playing.detail: If he engages with E (Apprehend) at levels 3-5, dash through him with your E immediately since it heals on ability damage and repositions you out of his follow-up Q swing.

playing.title: Time R (World Ender) for fear value
playing.detail: R has a 120/100/80/80/80s cooldown and fears nearby minions; use it at level 6 to remove his minion wave control during an all-in and extend your healing and Move Speed through the fight.

playing.title: Never let him hit 5 stacks in melee range
playing.detail: At max Hemorrhage stacks Darius enrages with massive bonus AD — if you see 4 stacks on your health bar icon, disengage immediately even if you think you can win the exchange.

playing.title: Punish his R (Noxian Guillotine) cooldown after a miss
playing.detail: If he uses Guillotine and does not get the kill, its base cooldown is 120/100/80s (6s only on takedown) — this is your window to all-in without fear of the true-damage execute.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, boots, and summoner spells reflect measured games on the current patch (16.18.1) via OP.GG; the trade-timing and stack-management reasoning is my own tactical read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Do not get pulled by Darius’s (E). Purchase Plated Steelcaps first to manage your distance properly. Try to engage him whenever your abilities come off cooldown.
